name: Puppet Theory
body:
Your puppet minions can perform complex tasks.

Prerequisite(s): Puppeteer spell-like ability, Refined Gestures, Sleight of Hand 9 ranks

Benefit(s): Choose two skills based on physical ability scores. You are considered to have ranks in those skills equal to your character level for the purposes of controlling a body through Puppeteer. You may take this feat multiple times. Each time you do, it applies to different skills.
